q: An MCP server for a legal-document workflow exposes a saved instruction such as "Summarize this contract's indemnification clauses," which users pick from a menu inside the Claude application rather than the model deciding to run it on its own. Which primitive does this capability map to?
o: A tool, because it performs an action within the document workflow
A prompt, a user-controlled reusable template invoked explicitly rather than by model decision
A resource, since it packages reference content for the model to read
A sampling request, since the server is asking the client to generate a completion
e: Prompts are the user-controlled primitive: reusable templates a user explicitly selects, never triggered automatically. Tools are model-controlled actions the LLM invokes on its own judgment, which doesn't match a capability chosen from a menu. Resources are application-controlled read-only data pulled into context, not something a user runs. Sampling is a separate MCP mechanism where the server asks the client's model to complete something, unrelated to user-selected templates.
